construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: Object with schema_version, synthetic=true, catalog feed, customers, orders/baskets, clickstream event array, feedback, supplied sources and questions. Unknown fields are rejected.
shared_schema.catalog: currency and products with unique SKU, name, integer price_cents and stock.
shared_schema.profiles: Unique customer ID, invented persona and explicit personalization/withdrawn booleans.
shared_schema.orders: Customer reference, basket/completed status, SKU lines with positive integer quantity and catalog-matching unit_price_cents.
shared_schema.event_log: Unique event ID, customer and SKU references, event type, timezone-bearing ISO timestamp and displayed catalog price/stock.
shared_schema.feedback: Unique ID, customer/SKU references, optional order reference, review/service kind, text and synthetic=true. Reviews require a matching completed order.
shared_schema.sources: Unique ID, title, supplied text, synthetic=true and structured catalog_claims validated against the catalog.
shared_schema.output: status=ok plus data carrying the same envelope with cumulative documents, insights and research sections; stage=research. Errors are a single JSON object with status=error and message, exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One validate() layer validates entity fields, identifiers, relationships, industry constraints and deterministic derived-stage integrity at every handoff.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated extracted feedback, offer, order and clickstream rows; active consent from the shared customer profiles.
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Overlapping keyword themes with exact feedback IDs, product behavior metrics and consent-gated in-stock offers.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated theme counts, provenance and actions, plus document-stage questions, source rows and catalog offers retained in the same envelope.
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Decision questions with ranked lexical evidence, extractive findings, cited theme actions and explicit insufficient-evidence results.

behavior: Document automation extracts and reshapes JSON entities, trims feedback boundaries, computes integer line totals and verifies relationships.
Customer insights categorize supplied feedback deterministically, retain unmatched feedback under other, distinguish basket events from completed sales and never generate review text.
Research uses only supplied synthetic materials, observed themes and authoritative catalog facts. Evidence-found means lexical relevance, not a proven answer.
Personalization requires explicit consent and no withdrawal. Nonconsenting profiles receive no personalized offers; aggregate feedback still contributes to themes.
Displayed offers, basket/order prices and structured source price/stock claims must match the input catalog snapshot.
Free-text source claims are retained as unverified quotations, not independently fact-checked; structured catalog assertions are authoritative for price and stock.
Synthetic fixture review provenance is checked against synthetic completed orders; this does not verify real-world purchase authenticity.
No compliance certification is claimed. No external research, providers, or generated endorsements.

included: Traceable extractive evidence and data-integrity checks
excluded: Real-world identity, consent or review authenticity verification
Causal inference, sentiment scoring or statistical generalization
Currency conversion, historical pricing and inventory reconciliation
External document parsers or internet research

unittest.coverage: All three stages, both handoffs, propagation, provenance, consent and withdrawal, catalog consistency, empty inputs, invalid types and references, tampering, determinism, CLI success and error contracts.

cli.stdout: Exactly one valid JSON object with status=ok and data.stage=research.

test_outcomes.deliverable_inventory: Verified exactly the four required files and no generated cache files.
